Open Problem 16.3 (Diameter of MST on high-dimensional tori). Show that the diameter of the MST on high-dimensional tori, as well as on the hypercube, is of order V 1/3, where V denotes the volume of the torus. Open Problem 16.4 (Scaling limit of MST on high-dimensional tori). Show that the scaling limit of the MST on high-dimensional tori, as well as on the hypercube, with distances rescaled by V −1/3, converges in distribution to a multiple of the scaling limit on the complete graph as identiﬁed in Theorem 16.3.
